basic_info.description: Little Hollywood neighborhood. Good Pied-a-terre option or Airbnb. 3 bdrms with 2.5 baths 1,716 sqft home. 2-car garage with storage space. No HOA.  Enter the entryway to a marbled hallway which takes you to the garage, stairs to the upper living quarters, or to the lower living space which includes modern kitchen with new lights fixtures, painting, new faucet, and a new dishwasher. Open concept dining/living room combo with access to a rear deck adds a very special feel. Tall ceilings accentuate the beauty and luxurious living space, with massive sunlight permeating through the many windows. Upstairs are 3 bedrooms with a master ensuite, walk-in closet and sequestered toilet. It has been masterfully updated with fresh paint, new plumbing fixtures and new carpeting. The massive views from the master bedroom ensuite are just breath taking. There are 2 skylights in the stairwell, and a skylight in each bathroom upstairs. Come to our Open House both Saturday & Sunday, or have your agent to schedule a private in-person Tour for you. Several transportation options nearby: CalTrain station to Silicon Valley or to SF Giants games, Muni T-Train to Chinatown and Warrior games, as well as SAMTRANS to downtown SF or Southbay. Candlestick Reserve & McLaren Park for family recreation.
